rules.title: Dhanushkodi: road open in daylight only
rules.detail: Travel writers give 6 am to 6 pm at the check post; visitor reviews say police clear the area from 5 pm. No government order was found.

source.title: Dhanushkodi - Uncover The Secrets Of A Deserted Old Town

rules.title: Arichal Munai: visitors' vehicles to stop short soon
rules.detail: The forest department plans to halt visitors' vehicles at Kambipadu and carry people the last five kilometres in its own gas buses. No start date given.
rules.applies_to: Visitors' vehicles and government buses; two-wheelers not named

rules.title: East Coast Road toll stretch: 80 kilometres an hour
rules.detail: The tolled stretch from Uthandi towards Puducherry has 22 bends and an 80 limit. The source is an encyclopedia; no order was found.

source.title: East Coast Road
East Coast Road

season.note: The state tourism office names October to March; the northeast monsoon brings the wet season from August to December and the coast is prone to cyclones.

hazards.title: Wind-blown sand on the Dhanushkodi road
hazards.detail: Strong wind drives sand across the road hard enough to make it difficult for motorcycles.

source.title: Dhanushkodi - Uncover The Secrets Of A Deserted Old Town

hazards.title: Cyclones and monsoon rain on the coast
hazards.detail: Nagapattinam lies in a cyclone-prone zone. The wet season runs from August to December.

source.title: Nagapattinam

hazards.title: Strong currents at Dhanushkodi beach
hazards.detail: Visitors are kept out of the water because of strong currents where two seas meet.

source.title: Dhanushkodi - Uncover The Secrets Of A Deserted Old Town

hazards.title: No services at Dhanushkodi
hazards.detail: No hotels or cash machines beyond Rameswaram. Be back before the check post shuts.

source.title: Dhanushkodi - Uncover The Secrets Of A Deserted Old Town

hazards.title: Busy bends on the East Coast Road
hazards.detail: About 40,000 vehicles a day use the road near Chennai, and the toll stretch has 22 bends.

source.title: East Coast Road
